title: Assessing Cross-Version Simcyp Simulator Prediction Performance Using a Bioequivalence Framework to Support EMA Qualification
summary: See how Simcyp Simulator V20–V24 DDI predictions were shown equivalent to the EMA-qualified V19 using a bioequivalence (TOST) framework across 220 AUC and 159 Cmax studies.
